description.value: A private lakeside resort near Lone Butte in the BC Cariboo, open May–October for tent camping, with resort-grade flush toilets, coin showers, laundry, kayak rentals, and a dock on a quiet fly-fishing lake. The Fawn Lake Access Road is likely gravel, and a 50% deposit is required to reserve a site.
